problems.description: Employees receive emails impersonating executives requesting urgent wire transfers or sensitive data, leveraging social engineering to bypass normal verification.
risk_reduction: Implement email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Train employees to verify unusual requests through secondary channels
Use advanced email filtering and threat intelligence to detect spoofing

problems.description: Phishing emails contain malicious attachments disguised as invoices or reports that, when opened, install ransomware on corporate endpoints.
risk_reduction: Deploy endpoint protection with real-time malware scanning
Block or sandbox email attachments from unknown senders
Conduct regular phishing awareness campaigns and simulated attacks

problems.description: Spear-phishing campaigns target HR personnel to steal employee PII for identity theft or further social engineering attacks.
risk_reduction: Limit access to sensitive employee data on a need-to-know basis
Monitor email traffic for targeted phishing indicators
Enforce multi-factor authentication for access to HR systems

problems.description: Attackers send phishing emails with links to fake cloud service login pages to harvest user credentials and gain unauthorized access to cloud environments.
risk_reduction: Enable multi-factor authentication on all cloud accounts
Use browser isolation or URL filtering to block malicious sites
Educate users on recognizing phishing attempts targeting cloud services

problems.description: Phishing emails exploit cloud collaboration tools by embedding malicious links or files in shared documents, spreading malware within the organization.
risk_reduction: Implement strict sharing permissions and link expiration policies
Scan shared files for malware before allowing downloads
Train users to verify unexpected shared content before interacting

problems.description: Compromised cloud admin credentials obtained via phishing enable attackers to modify infrastructure configurations and deploy malicious workloads.
risk_reduction: Enforce least privilege and role-based access control for cloud admins
Monitor and alert on unusual admin activity and configuration changes
Rotate credentials regularly and use hardware security modules (HSMs)

problems.description: Individuals receive SMS or email messages impersonating banks or service providers, tricking them into revealing passwords or installing malicious apps.
risk_reduction: Advise users to verify communications through official channels
Use mobile security apps that detect and block phishing attempts
Encourage enabling two-factor authentication on personal accounts

problems.description: Phishing websites mimic popular social media login pages to steal credentials, leading to account takeover and identity theft.
risk_reduction: Promote use of password managers to detect fake sites
Educate users on checking URLs and SSL certificates before login
Enable multi-factor authentication on social media accounts

problems.description: Phishing emails target personal email accounts with fake notifications about package deliveries or account suspensions to harvest login credentials.
risk_reduction: Use email providers with strong spam and phishing detection
Avoid clicking links or downloading attachments from unknown senders
Regularly update passwords and monitor account activity
